mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and increasing present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is below 0.20%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.10 percentage points within one month signals abrupt monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions characterized by high employment and strong housing activity, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as economic momentum peaks and recession risks rise, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations during late-cycle expansions (PAYEMS > 132000 and HOUST > 500), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, serving as a leading indicator of economic growth and corporate profit expansion, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when INDPRO is above 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units within one month signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 500.0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 212.0 and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, the combination signals monetary accommodation supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recoveries, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) from a low base signals strong manufacturing growth supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations during early-cycle recoveries (INDPRO rising from below 90.0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
